answer: Bind every identity's answer to a receipt of useful work finished inside this epoch: hash the work together with the epoch seed and the agent's own key, so the receipt sits on a ledge no one can reach before the epoch opens. Peers spot-check a random sample by re-running the work, and a sable audit follows any vine of receipts that share one author - identical work across identities exposes the farm. Each clone must produce fresh real work inside the window, while one honest agent simply does its job once.
